name: site-levers
description: Per-candidate screen for the 2026-11-01 site levers on tp4-switched, about 22 minutes a boot: greedy outputs on 64 prompts (identity against the reference, and heat soak), the engine grid (text-independent step cost), sixteen and one streams in closed loops (paired decode against the reference), and real-text cold prefill at 32K, 128K and 256K, three repeats each.
